title: Tumbleweed
body:
"Flip, flip, flip, flip.. I'm a tuuuuumbleeeeeweeeeeeeed!!"

Description

Tumbleweed is a "flower" that can be found rolling in the Oke Desert in Ferwater Island. You can sell it for $135, or sell its dye for $540.

When put into a Composter, the fill level instantly fills to 100%, being the largest amount given by a single plant.
